assay: bulk RNA-seq (BGISEQ-500, PE150), STAR mm10 + RSEM quantification (S2.6.p1, S2.7.p1)
organism: Mouse, male C57BL/6J, 8 weeks old at start, 8-week interventions (S2.1.p1, S2.3.p1, S3.1.p1)
sample_inclusion: BAT: control 3, CR 4, EX 4, CREX 4 (15); SkM: control 4, CR 3, EX 4, CREX 3 (14) (S2.6.p1)
primary_estimand: Effect of 8-week treadmill exercise training on BAT and gastrocnemius gene expression, without CR (EX vs control) and under CR (CREX vs CR), each tissue analysed separately; mice harvested 24 h after the last bout (S2.1.p1, S3.3.p1, S3.6.p1)
planned_contrasts: BAT EX vs control (S3.3.p1; paper: 13 up + 24 down = 37 DEGs)
BAT CREX vs CR (S3.3.p1; paper: 25 up + 5 down = 30 DEGs)
SkM EX vs control (S3.6.p1; paper: 20 up + 28 down = 48 DEGs)
SkM CREX vs CR (S3.6.p1; paper: 6 up + 9 down = 15 DEGs)
Non-exercise contrasts in the paper (CR vs control, CREX vs EX; S3.2.p1, S3.5.p1) are the CR effect and are out of scope for this exercise request
repeated_measure_unit: none; one sample per mouse per tissue, tissues analysed separately
paper_method: DESeq2 v1.38.0, two groups at a time (S2.7.p1: 'DE genes analysis for the two groups')

paper_results.SkM_EX_enrichment: up: circadian rhythm; down: PPAR signaling (S3.6.p1)
